summary: Iteration 31 - Per-date availability tooltip on parking slots in multi-date booking mode. 5 TOOLTIP test cases executed. 4 PASS, 1 PARTIAL (TOOLTIP-03 could not test occupied-slot tooltip due to clean test environment with no occupied slots). The tooltip feature is working correctly end-to-end.

TOOLTIP-01.description: Multi-date mode (Mar 1 + Mar 2): Blue info banner appears with 'Showing combined availability across all 2 selected dates'. Parking map shows 10 slots. Hovering over slot 1A1 shows tooltip with header '1A1 — per date', two date rows: 'Sun, Mar 1 free' and 'Mon, Mar 2 free' with green checkmarks.
TOOLTIP-01.tooltip_content: 1A1 — per date | Sun, Mar 1 free | Mon, Mar 2 free

TOOLTIP-02.description: Single-date mode (Mar 1 only): Parking map shows 10 slots. Hovering over slot 1A1 shows NO date-breakdown tooltip. Single-date mode renders slots as React.Fragment (no Tooltip wrapper), so no custom tooltip fires.
TOOLTIP-02.notes: No multi-date banner visible in single-date mode (correct)

TOOLTIP-03.description: Multi-date mode (Mar 1 + Mar 2): All 10 slots are available in the clean test environment (no occupied slots). Cannot fully test 'occupied slot shows tooltip with booked date entries'. However, tooltip mechanism confirmed working for available slots (same Tooltip wrapper wraps all slots when selectedDates.length > 1). Code review confirms occupied slots with pointer-events:none are wrapped in a span that receives hover - the logic is correctly implemented.
TOOLTIP-03.notes: Clean environment - no maintenance or existing bookings on Mar 1/2. Tooltip verified working on 3 available slots.

TOOLTIP-04.description: Multi-date mode (Mar 1 + Mar 2): Clicking available slot 1A1 selects it (shows checkmark, dark border) and opens timeline panel with 'Select Hours for 1A1'. Timeline shows all 24 hour blocks. Core map functionality intact after tooltip enhancement.

TOOLTIP-05.description: 3 dates selected (Mar 1, Mar 2, Mar 3): Banner shows '3 selected dates'. Tooltip shows exactly 3 date entries: 'Sun, Mar 1 free', 'Mon, Mar 2 free', 'Tue, Mar 3 free'. Days counter badge shows '3 days'.
TOOLTIP-05.tooltip_content: 1A1 — per date | Sun, Mar 1 free | Mon, Mar 2 free | Tue, Mar 3 free

issues: Radix UI Portal renders tooltip DOM content duplicated in raw text (Radix internal behavior - visual rendering is correct with 2/3 entries only). Not a visual bug.

critical_code_review_comments: BookingPage.js line 660: Occupied slots have `pointerEvents: 'none'` on the button, wrapped in span. This is the correct approach for Radix Tooltip to work on disabled elements. Tooltip wrapping logic (showDateTooltip = selectedDates.length > 1 && slot.dateAvailability?.length > 0) is correct.
The tooltip text duplication in raw DOM text (not visual) is a known Radix UI Portal behavior where content is rendered in two places for accessibility/animation. Visual display is correct.
TOOLTIP-03 could not be fully verified in clean environment - no occupied slots available. Consider adding a test fixture with a maintenance-blocked slot for future regression testing.
